content:
Two people were booked into the Webb County Jail overnight on alleged misdemeanor charges, according to Webb County booking records.

Humberto Bernal Jr. was arrested Tuesday night, October 20, 2026, at 10:00 p.m. and booked on one count of TERRORISTIC THREAT OF FAMILY/HOUSEHOLD — a Class A misdemeanor under Texas law, alleging a threat of violence against a family or household member. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record; it lists his city as Laredo, Texas.

John Anthony Lozano was arrested Tuesday afternoon, October 20, 2026, at 5:20 p.m. and booked on one count of DRIVING WHILE INTOXICATED — a Class B misdemeanor under Texas law, alleging operating a motor vehicle in a public place while intoxicated. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record; it lists his city as Laredo, Texas.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Humberto Bernal Jr. and John Anthony Lozano are presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Oct. 21, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956

title: Police Blotter: 2 booked on misdemeanor charges in Webb County
